name: Archiver
tip: Storage you volunteered for other people. A quota is a ceiling, not a target — and nothing of yours is ever evicted to make room.

children.name: quota
children.tip: Tap the quota to raise it in 5 GB steps; past 50 GB it returns to zero — revoking must be as easy as granting.

name: Space
tip: Where the space went, and how to get it back. Every cleanup says what it will free before it frees it.

children.name: space
children.tip: Statistics, biggest depositors, and previewed cleanups. Tap a cleanup to run exactly what it showed you.
